market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil >$100 and Middle East escalation drive risk-off. Dow -475 pts signals stress. Treasury buyback ineffective. Expect continued volatility until Iran conflict de-escalates or Fed signals clarity. Energy outperforms; tech mixed on AI strength vs. rate pressure.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Wilson maintains bull thesis. AI capex cycle structurally intact (Broadcom, Qualcomm, CoreWeave demand). Consumer spending resilient. Trade wars and oil are cyclical, not structural. Battery decoupling from China is multi-year but $500M insufficient—expect policy escalation. 6-12 month: recovery likely post-oil shock.
